Drive into the other lane to reduce the turning radius.
Drive into the curve at the current speed so as not to hold up the traffic behind.

ko_b: 다음 중 대형화물자동차의 선회특성과 진동특성에 대한 설명으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
ko_c: 진동각은 차의 원심력에 크게 영향을 미치지 않는다.
진동각은 차의 중심높이에 크게 영향을 받지 않는다.

Accidents involving collisions are more likely due to the vibration level of a large truck being lower than that of  passenger cars.

Transport of cargo must not be refused unless there is a valid reason.
The vehicle should be kept clean only when carrying high-priced cargo.
Be sure to check the placement of covers and packaging used to hold cargo in place when the destination is reached.

ko_c: 도착 즉시 사고차량을 견인하여 정비소로 이동시킨다.

tr_b: Which of the following is the most appropriate action for the driver of a recovery vehicle upon arrival at the  scene of an accident?
tr_c: Collect the driver's license belonging to the driver of the vehicle that was involved in the accident.
Immediately upon arrival, tow the vehicle involved in the accident to a maintenance shop.
Negotiate the cost of repairs with the driver of the vehicle that was involved in the accident.
Check the driver of the vehicle involved in the accident for any injuries, and take safety measures to prevent further  accidents.

피견인차량을 견인 시 법규를 준수하고 안전하게 견인한다.
견인차의 이동거리별 요금이 고가일 때만 안전하게 운행한다.
사고차량 발생 시 사고현장까지 신호는 무시하고 가도 된다.
tr_b: Which of the following is the most desirable action for a recovery vehicle driver?
tr_c: Reach the location of a vehicle breakdown as soon as possible and tow the vehicle immediately.
When towing a vehicle, obey the laws and safely proceed with towing.

Ignore signals while on the way to the location of a breakdown.

본선 주행차로에서 빠르게 진행하는 차량에 주의
견인자동차는 눈에 확 띄므로 크게 신경 쓸 필요가 없다.

Watch out for fast-moving vehicles in the main lane.

tr_c: Check the injured for consciousness.
Check the injured for breathing.
Check the injured for bleeding.

ko_b: 다음 중 구난차의 각종 장치에 대한 설명으로 맞는 것은?
ko_c: 크레인 본체에 달려 있는 크레인의 팔 부분을 후크(hook)라 한다.
구조물을 견인할 때 구난차와 연결하는 장치를 PTO스위치라고 한다.
작업 시 안정성을 확보하기 위하여 전방과 후방 측면에 부착된 구조물을 아우트리거라고 한다.
크레인에 장착되어 있으며 갈고리 모양으로 와이어 로프에 달려서 중량물을 거는 장치를 붐(boom)이라 한다.
tr_b: Which of the following is a correct description of equipment attached to a recovery vehicle?
tr_c: The arm structure hung from the main body of the crane is called a hook.
The device used to connect the recovery vehicle to a structure when towing is called the PTO switch.
The structure attached to the front and rear sides in order to secure stability during tasks is called an outrigger.
The device installed on the crane and on which a weighted item is hooked with a wire rope is called a boom.

ko_b: 구난차 운전자가 FF방식(Front engine Front wheel drive)의 고장차를 구난하는 방법으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ko_c: 반드시 차체 전체를 들어 올려 견인한다.
tr_b: Which of the following is the most appropriate method for the driver of a recovery vehicle to tow a broken  down vehicle with an FF layout (Front engine Front wheel drive)?
tr_c: Tow by lifting the front part of the vehicle.
Tow by lifting the rear part of the vehicle.
It does not matter which part is lifted.
Tow by lifting the entire vehicle.

ko_b: 구난차 운전자가 교통사고현장에서 한 조치이다. 가장 바람직한 것은?

주간에는 잘 보이므로 별다른 안전조치 없이 견인준비를 했다.
사고당사자에게 일단 심리적 안정을 취할 수 있도록 도와줬다.

tr_c: Advise the parties involved in the accident to pursue a civil settlement.
Immediately tow the crashed vehicle without consulting the parties involved in the accident.
Just prepare for towing without taking any safety measures, as visibility is good in daytime.
Help the driver of the vehicle that crashed to calm down.

ko_b: 구난차 운전자가 교통사고 현장에서 부상자를 발견하였을 때 대처방법으로 가장 바람직한 것은?
ko_c: 말을 걸어보거나 어깨를 두드려 부상자의 의식 상태를 확인한다.
골절 부상자는 즉시 부목을 대고 구급차가 올 때까지 기다린다.

If the injured person is not conscious, attempt CPR.
For a person with a fracture, immediately support the fractured area with a splint and wait until an ambulance arrives.
For severe bleeding, position the bleeding area below the heart.

ko_b: 교통사고 발생 현장에 도착한 구난차 운전자가 부상자에게 응급조치를 해야 하는 이유로 가장 거리가 먼 것은?

tr_c: To facilitate the speedy transport of the victim
To protect the life of the injured.
To protect the victim's assets
To increase the chances of the victim's survival

ko_b: 다음 중 자동차의 주행 또는 급제동 시 자동차의 뒤쪽 차체가 좌우로 떨리는 현상을 뜻하는 용어는?

tr_c: Fishtailing
Hydroplaning

ko_b: 다음 중 구난차 운전자의 가장 바람직한 행동은?
ko_c: 화재발생 시 초기진화를 위해 소화 장비를 차량에 비치한다.
사고현장에 신속한 도착을 위해 중앙선을 넘어 주행한다.
교통사고 운전자와 동승자를 사고차량에 승차시킨 후 견인한다.
tr_b: Which of the following actions is appropriate for the driver of a recovery vehicle?
tr_c: Carry a fire extinguisher within the vehicle for early suppression of fire.
Drive past the centerline to rush to the scene of an accident.
In a minor accident, persuade the drivers to settle the issue.
Take both the driver and the passenger, and then tow the vehicle involved in the accident.

ko_b: 제한속도 매시 100킬로미터 고속도로에서 구난차량이 매시 145킬로미터로 주행하다 과속으로 적발되었다. 벌점과  범칙금액은?
tr_b: A recovery vehicle was caught driving at 145 km/h on an expressway with a 100 km/h speed limit. Which of the  following corresponds to the correct demerit points and traffic penalty?
tr_c: 70 demerit points and traffic penalty of KRW 140,000
60 demerit points and traffic penalty of KRW 130,000
30 demerit points and traffic penalty of KRW 100,000
15 demerit points and traffic penalty of KRW 70,000

ko_b: 다음 중 구난차 운전자가 자동차에 도색(塗色)이나 표지를 할 수 있는 것은?
ko_c: 응급상황 발생 시 연락할 수 있는 운전자 전화번호
tr_b: Which of the following may be painted or marked on a recovery vehicle?
tr_c: Vehicle painting and signs similar to those used on a traffic control vehicle
Vehicle painting and signs similar to those used on a crime investigation vehicle
Vehicle painting and signs similar to those used on an emergency vehicle
Indication of the driver's phone number to be called in case of an emergency

ko_b: 구난차 운전자가 RR방식(Rear engine Rear wheel drive)의 고장차를 구난하는 방법으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ko_c: 반드시 차체 전체를 들어 올려 견인한다.
tr_b: Which of the following is the most appropriate method for the driver of a recovery vehicle to tow a broken  down vehicle with an RR layout (Rear engine Rear wheel drive)?
tr_c: Tow by lifting the front part of the vehicle.
Tow by lifting the rear part of the vehicle.
It does not matter which part is lifted.
Tow by lifting the entire vehicle.

ko_b: 교통사고 현장에 출동하는 구난차 운전자의 운전방법으로 가장 바람직한 것은?
ko_c: 긴급자동차에 해당됨으로 최고 속도를 초과하여 주행한다.
고속도로에서 차량 정체 시 경음기를 울리면서 갓길로 주행한다.
신속한 도착도 중요하지만 교통사고 방지를 위해 안전운전 한다.
tr_b: Which of the following is the most desirable way to drive a recovery vehicle when responding to an accident  scene?
tr_c: Speedy arrival is the foremost priority, so it is acceptable to drive on the opposite side.
It is acceptable to drive over the speed limit because a recovery vehicle is classified as an emergency vehicle.
On a congested expressway, drive along the roadside while honking loudly.
Drive safely to prevent more accidents, while striving to get to the scene of the accident as quickly as possible.

ko_b: 다음 중 자동차관리법령상 특수자동차의 유형별 구분에 해당하지 않는 것은?
tr_b: Which of the following does NOT correspond to the classification of special motor vehicle types under the  Motor Vehicle Management Act?
tr_c: Vehicle used for towing
Vehicle used for special operation
Vehicle used for recovery
Vehicle used for emergency gas recovery

ko_b: 제1종 특수면허 중 소형견인차면허의 기능시험에 대한 내용이다. 맞는 것은?
ko_c: 소형견인차 시험은 굴절, 곡선, 방향전환, 주행코스를 통과하여야 한다.
소형견인차 시험 코스통과 기준은 각 코스마다 5분 이내이다.
소형견인차 시험 각 코스의 확인선 미접촉 시 각 5점씩 감점된다.
tr_b: Which of the following statements regarding the driving skills test for a Class I driver’s license for small towing  vehicles is correct?
tr_c: The participant is required to score at least 90 out of 100 to pass.
The participant is required to pass the bent course, curved course, change of direction, and driving tests.
The pass criteria for the small towing vehicle test course is within 5 minutes for each course.
The participant will lose 5 points every time he or she fails to touch the confirmation line on each test course.

ko_b: 구난차로 고장차량을 견인할 때 견인되는 차가 켜야 하는 등화는?
tr_b: When a recovery vehicle is towing a vehicle that has broken down, which of the following lights should the  vehicle being towed turn on?
tr_c: Headlights and emergency flashers
Headlights and taillights
Taillights, sidelights, and license plate lights
Left turn indicator

ko_b: 구난차 운전자가 지켜야 할 사항으로 맞는 것은?
ko_c: 구난차 운전자의 경찰무선 도청은 일부 허용된다.
구난차 운전자는 도로교통법을 반드시 준수해야 한다.
교통사고 발생 시 출동하는 구난차의 과속은 무방하다.
구난차는 교통사고 발생 시 신호를 무시하고 진행할 수 있다.
tr_b: Which of the following is an appropriate action for the driver of a recovery vehicle?
tr_c: In some instances, it is permissible for the driver of a recovery vehicle to use a police radio scanner.
The driver of a recovery vehicle must obey the Road Traffic Act.
A recovery vehicle may violate the speed limit when it is on the way to the scene of an accident.
In the event of an accident, a recovery vehicle may proceed without regard for traffic signals.
